enforcement_limit: The canonical owner and this schema live on a 9p drvfs mount without metadata, so a read-only file mode cannot be set (chmod 0700 on this path is observed to resolve back to 777). Write-once is therefore enforced by digest comparison - bin/fsc2-verify-freeze.sh re-hashes and refuses on any drift - and NOT by filesystem permission. Recorded as a real limit rather than an assumed protection.
